title: Line-item tagging proposal
description: What the model returns: one tag per line item it was given - a category id from the pinned taxonomy, the two inclusion flags, a confidence and a one-line rationale - and, where it leaned on one, the id of a precedent it was shown. No figure, no amount, no total: the model never sees a value and this schema has nowhere to put one. `confidence` is the only numeric property, and it is the model's own uncertainty, which the Confidence Router reads. Everything the proposal claims is checked by the procedure before it becomes output: the refs against the input, the categories against the taxonomy, the precedent ids against the store, in scope.

category.description: A category id from the pinned taxonomy, exactly as listed in the payload. `unmapped` when the description does not map.

confidence.description: How sure the model is of the category and both flags together. Below the engagement's bar it goes to a person.

rationale.description: One line: what in the description decided it. Never an amount.

precedent_ref.description: The id of a precedent shown in the context that this tag follows, or null. An id the store does not hold in this scope is dropped and the item is reviewed.

uncategorisable.description: The description is too sparse or too odd to place. Pairs with category `unmapped` and nothing else. Set this rather than guessing.

notes.description: Anything about the batch as a whole a reviewer should know.
